Crafts

More filters

Sell price is the lower of the recent average sale and the cheapest current listing on your world. Material cost uses the cheapest listing across your data center (or crafting or gathering it, when those are on and cheaper). Daily potential is profit × sales per day: the size of the opportunity, not a promise.

Gather

Raw materials worth selling straight from your Miner, Botanist and Fisher.

More filters

Timed windows use Eorzea time and update live. Zones come from game data; where the data has no zone, the expansion is estimated from the item's gathering level, so check in game.

Flips

Gil without crafting: buy low, sell on your world.
